facts.fact: Olivia 回房亲吻 Tamsin，试图抹去 Simon 的话。
facts.anchor: I quickly went in, closed the door behind me, grabbed her, and kissed her vehemently, trying to erase the memory of Simon’s words.

facts.fact: 庄园经理 Fairleigh 通知两人 Dickie 午饭后死亡。
facts.anchor: “Well, he was taken ill after lunch. Very ill, and he—expired.”

facts.fact: Fairleigh 转述 Barnes 医生认为可能是蜂蜇。
facts.anchor: Dr. Barnes thinks it might have been a bee sting.

facts.fact: Barnes 医生正式倾向黄蜂蜇伤说法。
facts.anchor: I think he suffered a bee sting. A wasp, probably—Mr. Devenish said he’d seen one flying about.

facts.fact: Fairleigh 说 de Voil 家的化装舞会连战时也未取消。
facts.anchor: The de Voils have never canceled their masquerade, not even during the war.

facts.fact: Beryl 因 Dickie 之死当众指责 Olivia。
facts.anchor: “He was supposed to be with me!” Beryl jabbed my chest. “You don’t even know him!”

facts.fact: Tallulah 挽着 Olivia 与 Tamsin，带她们离开围观。
facts.anchor: Tallulah linked her arms through ours.

facts.fact: Olivia 推断 Simon 楼上的提议是最后的救她尝试。
facts.anchor: Simon’s proposal upstairs had been a last-ditch attempt to save me.
